items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Because we had a lot of fun playing together, I'd go out and sit in with him, you know.

ctx.x: Going back to the Swing Club on Hollywood Boulevard and Las Palmas for a minute, because I have so many great memories from there. That's where I first met Illinois Jacquet. When I came here with Ernie Fields, he had his group with his brother Russell. They were playing. And he tried to persuade me to join his band. Because we had a lot of fun playing together, I'd go out and sit in with him, you know.

I also heard Calvin Jackson for the first time; he sat in with us at Billy Berg's. You know, Calvin Jackson, the great pianist and conductor. At the time, he was under contract to MGM as a musical director. This was in 1945.
